'''Terek Rogriss''' was the son of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]]. Born in [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]], when he came of age he followed his father into service in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. When the elder Rogriss defected in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] promised to get word to Terek and his sister [[Asori Rogriss|Asori]], and offer them the ability to join their father.
